t: $(item)Logistics Drones/$ are a special type of $(l:tools/drone)drone/$. They are a lower tier $(thing)Drone/$, since they are not programmable but limited to carrying out $(italic)only/$ logistics tasks.
$(item)物流无人机/$是一种特殊类型的$(l:tools/drone)无人机/$。它属于较低等级的$(thing)无人机/$，因为它们不能编程，只能执行$(italic)仅限/$物流相关的任务。

As with all types of Drone, these drones require $(l:base_concepts/pressure)pressure/$ to operate, and will automatically seek out $(l:tools/drone#charging)a Charging Station with a Dispenser Upgrade/$ if low on air.
与所有类型的雄蜂一样，这些雄蜂需要$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压力/$才能运作，并且在气压不足时会自动寻找$(l:tools/drone#charging)装有发射器升级的充气站/$。

Once deployed, a $(item)Logistics Drone/$ will operate on any inventory/tank with a $(l:logistics/frames)Logistics Frame/$ in a 33x33x33 cube centered on the block the drone was deployed at.$(p)Since these Drones frequently need to move items around, $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#speed)Speed/$ and $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#inventory)Inventory/$ upgrades are recommended for movement speed and carrying capacity.

一旦部署，$(item)物流无人机/$就会在以其部署位置所在方块为中心、33x33x33 立方体范围内，对任何带有$(l:logistics/frames)物流框架/$的容器/储罐进行运作。$(p)由于这些无人机经常需要搬运物品，建议安装$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#speed)速度/$和$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#inventory)容器/$升级，以提升移动速度和携带容量。
